title: 开饭撤场
brief: One metronome on rehearsal table at bottom center, X left, N right. Both rehearse counting, turn to scent of rice, lift one modest white rice bowl each from below crop, exit sideways after each other. Hold on empty stage with swinging metronome; the two peek back empty-handed and return to rehearsal.

board.title: 开饭撤场
poses: 0.00 s: Draw X left and N right, counting with mouths open and right index fingers raised; left hands rest visibly beside the single metronome on the bottom-center rehearsal table.
0.45 s: Both stop counting, turn their eyes and noses toward rice-scent curls rising beside their hips, and lower both hands toward the bottom crop.
0.85 s: Each lifts one modest white rice bowl through the bottom crop, supporting its sides with both visible hands and watching the rice.
1.25 s: X sidesteps left with the bowl level in both hands; N watches X while holding the second bowl at chest height.
1.65 s: X and X's bowl are fully offscreen left; N follows the departure by sidestepping through the right edge, carrying the second bowl in both hands.
2.05–3.05 s: Hold the empty stage and bottom-center table, with the single metronome's pendulum swinging.
3.25 s: X peeks around the left edge and N around the right edge, each showing both empty hands beside their face and looking toward the metronome.
3.80 s: Both step into their original positions, lower their visible empty hands beside the table, and look toward the metronome.
4.65 s: Both resume counting with mouths opening and right index fingers halfway raised, left hands resting beside the table, ready to complete the lift into pose one.
board.continuity: Use a fixed camera for a 4.8-second loop, keep the table and metronome base fixed while its pendulum swings, carry both bowls fully offscreen, and connect the distinct ninth pose smoothly to the first.
